# prismasdwan_site (Resource)

Manages a Prisma SD-WAN Site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Palo Alto Networks Inc. 2025
#
# Sample resource example for "site".
# This file is generated - do not edit by hand.
#
# Before using this example, configure the Prisma SD-WAN provider:
#
#   terraform {
#     required_providers {
#       prismasdwan = {
#         source  = "paloaltonetworks/prismasdwan"
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
#   provider "prismasdwan" {
#     host          = "api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com"
#     client_id     = "acmeuser@12345.iam.panserviceaccount.com"
#     client_secret = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
#     scope         = "tsg_id:12345"
#     auth_url      = "https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token"
#   }

resource "prismasdwan_site" "example" {
  address = {
    city      = "Santa Clara"
    country   = "United States"
    post_code = "95054"
    state     = "California"
    street    = "3000 Tannery Way"
    street2   = "Building A"
  }
  admin_state                     = "active"
  app_acceleration_enabled        = false
  branch_gateway                  = false
  description                     = "Managed by Terraform"
  element_cluster_role            = "SPOKE"
  element_system_limit_profile_id = "<element_system_limit_profile_id>"
  extended_tags = [{
    key        = "example_key"
    value      = "example_value"
    value_type = "example_value_type"
  }]
  location = {
    description = "Managed by Terraform"
    latitude    = 37.3541
    longitude   = -121.9552
  }
  multicast_peer_group_id                   = "<multicast_peer_group_id>"
  name                                      = "example_name"
  nat_policysetstack_id                     = "<nat_policysetstack_id>"
  policy_set_id                             = "<policy_set_id>"
  prefer_lan_default_over_wan_default_route = false
  security_policyset_id                     = "<security_policyset_id>"
  security_policysetstack_id                = "<security_policysetstack_id>"
  service_binding                           = "<domain_id>"
  sgi_config = {
    sgi_tag       = 10
    sgi_vendor_id = "SGI_VENDOR_ID_TYPE_8909"
  }
  tags = ["terraform"]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `element_cluster_role` (String) Element cluster role. Value: one of NONE, HUB, SPOKE, PA_WE_BR, PA_WE_DC, PA_CONN.

### Optional

- `address` (Attributes) Address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--address))
- `admin_state` (String) Admin state. Value: one of monitor, active, disabled.
- `app_acceleration_enabled` (Boolean) App acceleration enabled.
- `branch_gateway` (Boolean) Branch gateway.
- `description` (String) Description. Value: at most 1024 characters.
- `element_system_limit_profile_id` (String) Element system limit profile id.
- `extended_tags` (Attributes List) Extended tags. At most 10 items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--extended_tags))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object, assigned by the API. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `location` (Attributes) Location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `multicast_peer_group_id` (String) Multicast peer group id.
- `name` (String) Name. Value: at most 128 characters.
- `nat_policysetstack_id` (String) Nat policysetstack id. Value: at most 20 characters, matching `^-?[0-9]{1,20}$`.
- `network_policysetstack_id` (String) Network policysetstack id. Value: at most 20 characters, matching `^-?[0-9]{1,20}$`. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `perfmgmt_policysetstack_id` (String) Perfmgmt policysetstack id. Value: at most 20 characters, matching `^-?[0-9]{1,20}$`. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `policy_set_id` (String) Policy set id.
- `prefer_lan_default_over_wan_default_route` (Boolean) Prefer lan default over wan default route.
- `priority_policysetstack_id` (String) Priority policysetstack id. Value: at most 20 characters, matching `^-?[0-9]{1,20}$`. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `security_policyset_id` (String) Security policyset id.
- `security_policysetstack_id` (String) Security policysetstack id.
- `service_binding` (String) Service binding.
- `sgi_config` (Attributes) Sgi config. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sgi_config))
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags. At most 10 items. Each item: at most 1024 characters, matching `[^,\s]+`.
- `vrf_context_profile_id` (String) Vrf context profile id. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `x_etag` (Number) Etag for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `x_parameters` (Map of String) Path parameters for the resource, managed automatically by the provider.
- `x_schema` (Number) Schema version for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
